research_deadline_red_proof.failure: SDK cancellation observed and actual inner timeout expired; result.budget_reason was None instead of deadline. Outer-winner parameter passed.

delegate_snapshot_before_ci.issue: Owned research deadline must not be inferred from an early SDK TimeoutError
delegate_snapshot_before_ci.prior_report_status: Preserved as the dated first iteration; this report supersedes its unconditional TimeoutError budget classification.
delegate_snapshot_before_ci.root_cause: Exception type does not establish expiration of the owned research budget. The SDK can raise its own TimeoutError before any local timeout expires. The first synthesis fix inferred deadline from exception type, and the preexisting iteration caller separately forced the same reason. Both must rely on admission/deadline ownership rather than provider outcome.

changes.helper: Retain the real asyncio.Timeout context and set budget.reason=deadline only for TimeoutError with context.expired(). Keep existing workload reason_code=deadline for TimeoutError and provider_error for other exceptions.
changes.iteration: Remove unconditional budget.reason reassignment from the TimeoutError/BudgetExhausted handler. Keep its break into forced synthesis. ResearchBudget and the owned helper already persist actual exhaustion.
changes.tests: Four bounded combinations cover SDK TimeoutError/RuntimeError at iteration/synthesis, assert unexpired owned contexts, an unchanged 30-second budget, reason=None, expected fallback or error answer, known and unknown token accounting, and real workload-event reason classification. Retain controlled real-deadline ordering parameters and external cancellation/cleanup checks.

mutation_proofs.failure_reason: Both early SDK TimeoutError cases report deadline while all owned contexts remain unexpired.

mutation_proofs.mutation: Restore iteration caller's unconditional deadline assignment
mutation_proofs.failure_reason: The iteration SDK TimeoutError case reports deadline despite unexpired owned contexts; synthesis case remains correct.

No live provider, DB, Redis, .env, commit or push; tracked writes began only after root confirmed full xdist snapshot completion.
Early SDK TimeoutError keeps the existing workload classification while the independent request budget reason remains None.

proof_boundary: CI PostgreSQL/pgvector 17 and Redis 7 are disposable service containers.
Browser cases run in a required Chromium job; five skips in minimal Python unit CI are covered by that job.
Controlled mutations are bounded checks for the audited fault modes, not comprehensive mutation testing.
Live Telegram/provider dialogue and end-to-end production log ingestion are not measured.
